item.title: How Large Language Models (LLMs) Learn: Calculus and the Search for Understanding
item.description:
When you ask ChatGPT a question, it seems to respond instantly. What’s easy to forget is that every word it predicts comes from a long history of learning — billions of gradient steps slowly sculpting its understanding of language.

Large language models don’t memorize text. They optimize it. Behind that optimization lies calculus — not the kind you did with pencil and paper, but a sprawling, automated version that computes millions of derivatives per second.
